package.name: parameter_event_handler
package.description: rclpy's ParameterEventHandler, backported for Humble, which does not ship it. Taken from ForzaETH's race_stack, which carried it inside their stack_master; ours is ament_cmake and has no python module, and a node depending on stack_master would be a cycle anyway. It lives here so the nodes that watch each other's parameters - sector_tuner, ot_interpolator, state_machine - share one copy. Delete it when the distro provides it.
